d:
This time on Guest in the Newsroom, we have Amod Kumar Kanth, former DGP and 1974 batch IPS officer, who has investigated some of India's most high-profile cases. From handling the Indira Gandhi assassination and 1984 anti-Sikh riots to leading inquiries in cases like the Uphaar Cinema fire, Jessica Lal murder, and BMW hit-and-run, Amod Kanth has seen it all.
In this exclusive conversation, he speaks candidly about:
The biggest crime investigations of his career
The challenges of policing in critical moments of history
Unknown details from high-profile cases
